verdict.rationale: CSC's docs say it offers integrations 'via modern APIs' and 'secure application programming interfaces', but nothing documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Having APIs is adjacent to this story and earns no credit for a published spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
